Microsoft's Windows Implementation Library (WIL), vendored for NovaOS
====================================================================

Source: https://github.com/microsoft/wil (MIT, LICENSE),
commit f6f3069ab39fb19c1f89fa5f2d3aa8a1118ace43.
Kept, unchanged: include/ (the library is headers only), LICENSE and
ThirdPartyNotices.txt.

Microsoft's XAML sources (third_party/microsoft-ui-xaml) are written on
WIL's error handling (wil/result.h), resource wrappers and safe casts;
userland/windows_ui_xaml/build.py puts include/ on their search path.

To update: replace include/ with a newer commit's and rebuild.
